messages:
Lucy Chen: Heads up — Hartwell renewal is in flight. They want to move billing to 'Hartwell EU Ops' and shorten the term from 12mo -> 9mo (pro-rated). Procurement insists on PO + signature. SSO onboarding for their admin is delayed until next week, so DocuSign might not reach the right person. Need a path so we don't lose the renewal.
Sam Patel: Thanks. Do we already have a vendor code for the new billing entity? If not RevOps needs to create it before they can raise a PO. Also: clarify proration — do we pro-rate the remaining quarter or start a 9mo term from 2026-05-01?
Priya Narang: No vendor code on file. Sam — please confirm exact legal name + VAT for invoices. Also confirm whether they need Net30 or Net45. Can we offer CC fallback if PO timing slips?
Lucy Chen: Legal name per customer: Hartwell Technology EU Ltd, VAT EU123456. They prefer PO but said CC is a backup. They want the invoice bill-to displayed as 'Hartwell EU Ops'. I'll push CC as last resort but let's keep PO as primary.
Jonah Reed: Legal is fine with that entity name. For a 9mo term we need a short amendment to the SOW. I'll draft an amendment and a DocuSign template that updates the bill-to. Ping me once vendor code exists and I'll bind it.
doc-signer-bot: Created envelope `env_0x9f3a` using template `renewal-amendment-hartwell`. Status: awaiting recipient mapping.
Sam Patel: Creating vendor code now — ETA ~2 hours. Will post the code and PO instructions here. @Priya looping you in for proration rules and invoice cadence.
Priya Narang: Ack. I'll review mapping when Sam posts the code. Preference: if PO is used, invoice 9mo upfront; if CC fallback, invoice monthly. Need explicit customer confirmation on that.
Lucy Chen: I'll confirm payment cadence with Hartwell and ask if they can accelerate their SSO admin setup for signing. If they can't, I'll request an alternate signer. Customer said 'likely yes' to CC fallback. I'll update thread in ~2h.
Sam Patel: Vendor code created: `V-37421-HWEU`. PO instructions posted to the ticketing portal. Sharing snippet:
```
Vendor: V-37421-HWEU
Bill-to: Hartwell EU Ops
Payment terms: Net30 (unless customer confirms Net45)
```
Jonah Reed: Got it. I updated envelope `env_0x9f3a` with `bill_to: Hartwell EU Ops` and term note `9-month amendment, pro-rated from 2026-05-01`. Sent to primary signer (Hartwell Admin) — awaiting signature.
Lucy Chen: Thanks everyone. If signature isn't returned by EOD Friday I'll escalate CC fallback and queue the invoice flow. :thumbsup:
